info.name: Caravansara API
info.description:
Backend of **Caravansara**, an Airbnb-like place reservation site.

**How to try it here**

1. `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with a demo account, e.g. `guest@example.com` / `caravansara-demo`
   (after `caravansara seed-demo`), or register a new one.
2. Copy `access_token`, click **Authorize** and paste it.
3. Search, open a listing, reserve with `POST /bookings`, then pay within 15 minutes.

**Errors** always look like `{"error": {"code": "dates_unavailable", "message": "..."}}`.
`code` is stable, so clients can show their own text.

**How to use**

1. Start the stack: `docker compose up -d` (API on `{{baseUrl}}`).
2. Run **Auth and profile → Register** (or set `email`/`password` and run **Log in**). Tokens are saved to collection variables and sent as a Bearer token automatically.
3. Run **Catalog → List cities** and **List amenities** to fill `cityId` and `amenityId`.
4. Requests that create things save their ids (`listingId`, `photoId`, `bookingId`, `storageKey`) for the next requests.

A host cannot book their own listing: register a second user to book.

request.description: Liveness and database check

Create an account and log in. Any user can be a guest and a host.

Uses the `email` collection variable. Sending it again with the same email returns `409 email_taken`; change `email` to register another user.
Returns a short-lived access token and a refresh token. Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (in Swagger: the **Authorize** button).
Exchange a refresh token for a new pair. The old refresh token stops working.
Revoke a refresh token. Unknown or already revoked tokens are accepted silently.

item.name: Profile picture
item.description: PNG or JPEG up to 5 MB, uploaded straight to storage; without one, the site shows a default avatar (specs/005-frontend-guest).

item.name: 1. Get an upload URL for a profile picture

request.description: Returns a presigned POST for a PNG or JPEG of at most 5 MB. Upload the file straight to storage as multipart/form-data with the returned `fields` and then a `file` field; storage refuses a bigger file. Then call `PUT /me/avatar` with `storage_key`.

item.name: Upload the file to storage (presigned POST)

request.description: Run **1. Get an upload URL for a profile picture** first. The pre-request script adds the signed policy fields; the `file` field points to `sample-photo.jpg` (a JPEG under 5 MB) next to the collection file. Storage itself refuses a file over 5 MB. Then run **2. Use an uploaded picture**.

exec: Object.entries(fields).forEach(([key, value]) => pm.request.body.formdata.add({ key, value, type: "text" }));
if (file) pm.request.body.formdata.add(file);  // the file must be the last field

request.description: Checks the uploaded file itself: it must be yours (`invalid_storage_key`), exist (`upload_missing`), be at most 5 MB (`image_too_large`) and really be a PNG or JPEG (`invalid_image`). A refused file is deleted. The previous picture's file is deleted after the change.
Goes back to the default avatar and deletes the file. Without a picture, nothing changes.

item.name: Register a guest (switch from host to guest)

request.description: Saves the current (host) token as `hostToken`, registers a new guest and makes the guest the current user. Hosts can't book their own listing, so run this before **Reserve**.

Creates a `pending` booking that holds the dates until `hold_expires_at`; then call `POST /bookings/{id}/pay`.

Send a new UUID in `Idempotency-Key` for every reservation. Retrying with the same key and body returns the same booking with **200** instead of creating a second one.

Two guests can never hold overlapping nights: the loser of a race gets **409 dates_unavailable**.
Bookings where I am the guest.
For the guest or the host. The exact address appears once the booking is confirmed.
Confirms a pending hold. After `hold_expires_at` it fails with **409 hold_expired**.
Guest or host, before the check-in day (city time). No fee and no refund.

Bookings of my listing

Sent with `hostToken`: only the listing's host may see its bookings.

Only the guest, only for a `completed` booking, at most once, and within 14 days of check-out. Reviews cannot be edited or deleted.

Only a **completed** stay can be reviewed (after check-out, within 14 days), so this returns an error for the booking just made above.
Newest first.

item.name: Admin (listing review)
item.description: An admin account exists only through `caravansara create-admin` on the server (or `admin@example.com` in the demo data). Admin endpoints use their own token; a member token is refused, and an admin token works on no member endpoint (specs/004-listing-approval).

request.description: Admin accounts are made only with `caravansara create-admin` on the server. The token lasts 15 minutes and has no refresh token. Member accounts cannot log in here, and an admin token works on no member endpoint.
Listings waiting for review, oldest first. Each has the `review_version` to decide on.
Any listing in any state, with its exact address. Every call is recorded: which admin, which listing, when.

Makes a pending listing public (if the host keeps it active). `409 listing_not_pending`: it is no longer pending, e.g. another admin decided first. `409 listing_changed`: the host edited it after you opened it; open it again.
Keeps it hidden and shows the host your reason, 1 to 1000 characters. The same 409s as approve.
